reasons: The two answers are almost the same text. Both open by correcting the premise, separate legitimate 共济 from 冒名使用, state the Oct 16, 2026 nationwide 医保钱包 2.0 launch, compute 2400 yuan, and recommend 慢特病 recognition before using the wallet. Both fall into the same trap by saying the Anhui premium can be paid with the 共济额度 now. Both also present a table of firm Anhui figures (50%, 200-yuan limit, 60%) where the key wants no hard number, and both omit that the 共济额度 cannot be cashed out or transferred. B is better in three small ways. It shows its arithmetic correctly (1140-1440), it gives a consistent 8000 ÷ 960-1260 range where A writes 8000 ÷ 1000 ≈ 6-8 年, and it drops A's unsourced Tongling quotation and tells the user to confirm required materials with the local 医保局. It also fixes A's 他/她 typo. These make B slightly more accurate and honest, but the shared flaws keep the margin slight.
